title: WMQ adapt for version 9.4.2.0 Part 1
description:
Add new define and structure of WMQ based on version 9.4.2

Adapt name of range_string, value_string, etc. to correspond to the name of the define for better reliability

notes.body: @robionekenobi : Squash your commits and write a proper commit message, see https://gitlab.com/robionekenobi/wireshark/-/jobs/10066107277#L1106

Hi,
Will make a new MR, to be more on line with rules
